entries.note: The sender entered the item's data; the Croatian page reads "Pošiljatelj je unio podatke, pošiljka još nije predana Hrvatskoj pošti", not yet handed to Hrvatska pošta.
Accepted at the office the scan names. A facility abroad receiving an item that already moved on uses the same wording; the adapter reads that one as in transit.
An outbound item at the office of exchange; the Croatian page words it as being prepared for dispatch.
Dispatched from the office of exchange.
Dispatched from the office of exchange, at the office the scan names.
Relayed from the post abroad, without an office: its office of exchange sending the item on, minutes after receiving it.
Relayed from the post abroad, without an office: seen the day before the item went out for delivery, so the delivering office holding it, not a pickup point; a pickup is the wording that names one.
Relayed from the post abroad; seen in an archived capture of the tracker.
Relayed from the post abroad: the item presented to the destination's customs.
Relayed from the post abroad: customs handed the item back to the post, which goes on with it.

entries.wording: Delivery was redirected to the parcelstation
entries.note: Sent on to a parcel locker instead of the address.
Seen when an item nobody collected leaves the post office, just before it goes back to its sender.

entries.wording: Item can be picked up at the Post Office
entries.note: The office becomes the pickup point. Repeated while the item waits there.

entries.wording: The shipment has been handed over to the parcelstation
entries.note: Left in a parcel locker, which becomes the pickup point.
The Croatian page has two wordings for it, delivered and delivered to the recipient. Once the item is on its way back, the adapter reads a delivery as returned.
On its way back to the sender; the Croatian page reads "Pošiljka se vraća pošiljatelju".
